results.title: Abraham Lincoln Memorial Squad Brings Final Honors to Veterans in Illinois
results.description: For over two decades, volunteers from the Abraham Lincoln Memorial Squad have dedicated their time to ensuring veterans receive solemn and respectful final honors in Elwood, Illinois. Led by Navy veteran Mike Padgen, the group of more than 120 members performs precise ceremonies, including flag folding and taps, to provide closure and comfort to grieving families. Relying on donations and an annual golf fundraiser, the squad views their duty as both a sentimental obligation and a deeply rewarding service to those who served.
